title: N-2 descends along a finite extension of Noetherian domains
statement: Let $A\subseteq B$ be integral domains such that $A$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $B$ is a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. If $B$ is N-2 [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain], then $A$ is N-2: for every finite field extension $L$ [def-pc-field-extension] of the fraction field $K$ of $A$, the integral closure of $A$ in $L$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] is a finitely generated $A$-module.
